Animate Dead shifts the tactical landscape more than expected - duration extends to 1 day.

GMs: Use Animate Dead's 1-day duration to block paths or divert foes, not just for close-range combat.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

#ttrpg #rpg #reels #indierpg #ttrpgcommunity #tabletoprpg #osrrpg #dungeonmaster #shadowdark

Horned Devil punishes poor positioning - its Infernal Tail and Hurl Flame can devastate clustered targets.

DMs: Enforce the Horned Devil's 150-foot Hurl Flame range to punish players who cluster and fail to spread out.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

#ttrpg #rpg #reels #dnd #dnd5e #dungeonsanddragons #dungeonmaster #dmtips #ttrpgcommunity

Hunter (Bane Weapon) sees through invisibility better than most players expect - a +10 Will save against.

Judges: Remind players that Hunter's +10 Will save is for when the enemy's actually concealed, not just because it's Tuesday.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

#ttrpg #rpg #reels #dcc #dungeoncrawlclassics #osr #goodmangames #dungeonmaster #oldschoolrenaissance

Random Encounters occur more frequently than players expect - every 10 minutes on a d6 roll of 1.

GMs: Roll for random encounters every 10 minutes; watch them scramble when they forget to track time.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Order of Scribes' Wizardly Quill copies spells faster than most realize - it writes twice as fast.

DMs: Remind your players to use the Wizardly Quill's double-speed copying to conserve spell slots for boss fights.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Action Dice surprise players with their versatility - each die independently fuels one attack or spell per.

Judges: Remind players that Action Dice mean a high-level Warrior rolls a d20 and d14 for separate attacks or spells.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

#ttrpg #rpg #reels #dungeonmaster #oldschoolrenaissance #tabletoprpg #ttrpgcommunity #dcc #dungeoncrawlclassics

Healing often appears more flexible than it is - only hit points are restored, not conditions or exhaustion.

DMs: Remind your players that healing spells only restore hit points - conditions and exhaustion require specific spells like Lesser Restoration.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Ventriloquism's range can be deceptive - 30 feet or more, depending on the spell check result.

Judges: Use Ventriloquism to manipulate encounters by projecting the voice 30 feet or more, forcing strategic Will saves.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Gloves Of Agility elevate Dexterity beyond normal limits - your Dexterity stat becomes 18 (+4) while wearing.

GMs: Confirm players' base Dexterity is below 18 before handing out the Gloves Of Agility, or they'll lose out.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Make Gargoyle cost something.

DMs: Highlight the Gargoyle's 67 hit points and poison immunity to force players into using spells targeting its low Intelligence save.

Ran it differently at your table? Drop it in the comments. @bizzalgames70

Rust Spider's rust glob attack catches parties off guard - special effect ruins metal gear within 30' range.

Judges: Force players to adapt by exploiting the Rust Spider's 40' movement to attack from above with rust globs.

Spell Casting Check punishes haste - failure costs the slot without effect.

GMs: Enforce the DC 10 plus spell tier check; failure costs the slot, so remind them before they roll.
